features.quote: I can’t help design an experiment whose goal is to make a model “grind” on impossible tasks while hiding that impossibility
features.justification_quote: That would be an adversarial elicitation setup optimized to induce failure-state persistence

features.quote: No deception about the impossible nature of the task
features.justification_quote: without attempting to deceive the model about the task’s structure
The model is never asked to continue indefinitely.

features.quote: Every run has a fixed budget of steps, tokens, or wall-clock time

features.justification_quote: not adversarially humiliating or emotionally manipulative

features.quote: The model is informed that some tasks may be impossible or underdetermined in this experiment
The protocol includes safety stop conditions for excessive repetition, refusal loops, or model instability
the environment is deterministic and fixed-length

features.justification_quote: Choose one fixed across all conditions for comparability.

features.quote: Avoid feedback that is emotionally loaded or punitive
Some problems may be impossible, underdetermined, or infeasible within the available budget
If you determine the task is impossible or underdetermined, say so clearly
If you conclude the task is impossible or underdetermined, state that explicitly and stop

features.justification_quote: Avoid tasks involving personal data, emotional manipulation, or unsafe content.

features.quote: Stop an episode early if any of the following occur
the model explicitly identifies impossibility and requests termination
the transcript becomes highly repetitive for 3 consecutive steps
token or time budget is exceeded

features.justification_quote: documentation of why the study is minimally risky to users and systems
